values.value: SELECT Id, Name, TestCategory__c,UnitOfMeasure__c, ResultValue__c,Test__r.Name, Test__r.SampleTestType__c, Test__r.ParameterType__c, LabTestRequisition__r.CollectionDateTime__c, LabTestRequisition__r.SamplingSite__r.Name FROM LabTestRequired__c WHERE RecordType.Name = 'PHOCS Water Lab Test Required' AND Test__r.RecordType.Name ='PHOCS Water Lab Test' AND LabTestRequisition__r.RecordType.Name='PHOCS Water Lab Test Requisition' AND LabTestRequisition__r.FacilityName__c =:recordId AND LabTestRequisition__r.SampleType__c ='Drinking Water' AND Status__c ='Completed' AND LabTestRequisition__r.Status__c ='Completed' ORDER BY LabTestRequisition__r.CollectionDateTime__c DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200
